music.title: Music
music.description: Whole-home music through Music Assistant: the speakers each room plays on, sync-group presets, and playlist pills, for the Play Music page and for automations. It starts empty: choose the speakers in Configure, then add presets and playlists with the + buttons.

music_options.title: Speakers and volume
music_options.description: The rooms the Play Music page offers, and the volume every room is set to when a playlist starts. Room names and floors come from each speaker’s area.

data_description.speakers: Music Assistant players, one per room. Sync groups are added as presets, not here.
data_description.volume: Every room a playlist plays in is set to this.

music_homes.title: Each tablet’s room
music_homes.description: Each wall tablet signs in as its own user. The room picked here is what its Play Music page shows when nothing else is chosen, and wins when music plays in more than one place.

error.music_group_is_room: A sync group can’t also be a room. Add it as a preset instead.

user.title: Add a preset
user.description: A Music Assistant sync group, and the rooms it plays in. Home Assistant can’t read a sync group’s rooms, so they are picked here.

reconfigure.title: Edit preset
reconfigure.description: A Music Assistant sync group, and the rooms it plays in.

error.no_members: Pick the rooms it plays in.
error.not_a_speaker: Every room must be one of the configured speakers.
error.group_is_room: Pick the sync group player, not a room.

user.title: Add a playlist
user.description: A pill on the Play Music page. Pick one or more playlists from the Music Assistant library; they play as one shuffled queue.

data_description.chooser: Optional. Playlists with the same chooser name become ONE pill that asks which, like Decades.

reconfigure.title: Edit playlist
reconfigure.description: A pill on the Play Music page.

data_description.chooser: Optional. Playlists with the same chooser name become ONE pill that asks which, like Decades.

error.not_in_library: That playlist isn’t in the Music Assistant library. Pick one from the list, or add it to your library first.

music_play.name: Play music
music_play.description: Play a configured playlist on a set of rooms: a preset’s sync group, one room, or a new group.

music_transfer.name: Move or add rooms
music_transfer.description: Move what is playing to a set of rooms, or add rooms to it, keeping the queue and position.

source.name: Source
source.description: The player the music is on now.

music_stop.name: Stop music
music_stop.description: Stop and ungroup these rooms, or the whole house.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Leave empty for the whole house.

music_transport.name: Music transport
music_transport.description: Play/pause, next, previous, stop or volume on one player.

player.name: Player
player.description: A room or a preset’s group.

music_play_media.name: Play music item
music_play_media.description: Play one item from the library on a player (Browse Music).

player.name: Player
player.description: A room or a preset’s group.

music_not_set_up.message: Music is not added. Add it in Settings -> Devices & services -> HK Frontend -> Add feature.
